name: @veyq/crypto
//: The ONE thing `web/` and `admin-web/` share (ADR 0065). Not a general code-sharing package: no UI, no router, no state — only the operator-blind crypto suite, the cold account birth built on it, and the Emergency Kit codec that serializes that birth's Secret Key, because a second copy of THAT would be a security defect rather than a maintenance nuisance (the kit codec proved it: both packages write kits, their two copies were each tested only against themselves, and a change to one would have broken the other's kits unseen). The kit's PDF writer stays per package: this package depends on @noble/* alone. Consumed as TypeScript source (both consumers are Vite apps that compile it themselves), so there is no build step and no dist/ to drift from src/.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
